entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I hope you can help me. I need to return an item I just bought. It's the Urban Commuter Helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF78901. I just... I feel so bad about this. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I've never returned anything.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the helmet was delivered just three days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. On the website, it looked like a deep forest green, but in person, it's much brighter. It doesn't match my bike at all, and I was so excited. I really needed this money for some other things coming up.
I see. So the color wasn't quite what you expected. I can definitely understand wanting everything to match perfectly.
Exactly. And I haven't even taken it out of its packaging, the box is unopened. I just feel awful having to call and ask for a refund.

Please don't feel bad at all, Sarah. It's important to us that you're happy with your gear. Since you received the helmet just three days ago and it's a standard apparel item, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure? I was so worried.

Absolutely. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I'm processing the return authorization now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just attach it to the package and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex. You've really turned my day around. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
